name: Aeluma, Inc. Common Stock
description: Aeluma Inc is a semiconductor company specializing in sensors and communications. It is developing sensor technology for mobile devices and vehicles. The company develops novel optoelectronic devices for sensing and communications applications. The company manufactures devices using high-performance compound semiconductor materials on large-diameter substrates that are commonly used to manufacture mass-market microelectronics. The applications include mobile, automotive, AI, defense & aerospace, communication, AR/VR and quantum computing.
